results.title: The impact of ESG performance on OFDI mode choice - CoLab
results.content: # The impact of ESG performance on OFDI mode choice: the role of total factor productivity. We construct a theoretical model of ESG performance affecting enterprises’ Outward Foreign Direct Investment (OFDI) mode choice from the perspective of total factor productivity and empirically tests the model using data from Chinese listed companies. The mechanism analysis indicates that improving ESG performance primarily boosts corporate total factor productivity, which in turn effectively strengthens the willingness to choose the Greenfield Investment mode for corporate OFDI.
